oak_log.wiki_description: An oak is the most common tree in the game, found in a variety of biomes, available in several variants. birch_log.wiki_description: A birch is a tree that appears similar to a common oak in terms of height and leaves, but with light bark and pale wood. It is most commonly found in birch forest biomes. jungle_log.wiki_description: A jungle is a temperate biome full of dense vegetation which generate in areas with high humidity values, often next to forests. There are three varieties of jungles.

acacia_log.wiki_description: The acacia tree is found in the savanna biome. Acacia trees are around 8 blocks tall and feature distinct diagonal trunks, and may occasionally have multiple canopies.

dark_oak_log.wiki_description: A dark oak tree is a variant of the oak tree with a thick trunk. They are found in the dark forest biome.

white_wool.wiki_description: Sheep are common passive mobs that supply wool and mutton and are found in many of the grassy biomes.

string.wiki_description: Spiders are common neutral mobs that have the unique ability to climb walls.

porkchop.wiki_description: A pig is a common passive mob found in most grass biomes. Pigs are a source of porkchops and can be equipped with a saddle to be driven.

leather.wiki_description: A cow is a common passive mob and a source of leather, beef and milk. Cows are found in most grassy biomes.

beef.wiki_description: A cow is a common passive mob and a source of leather, beef and milk. Cows are found in most grassy biomes.

chicken.wiki_description: Chickens are common passive mobs found in most grassy biomes, and are the main source of chicken, feathers and eggs.

spider_eye.wiki_description: Spiders are common neutral mobs that have the unique ability to climb walls.

mutton.wiki_description: Sheep are common passive mobs that supply wool and mutton and are found in many of the grassy biomes.
